cases.name: Ridge and cliff leak: Sun Rock
cases.note: Sun Rock Retreat to the ground south-west of it. The ends stand about 110 yd apart in height (the baker's terrain: a 105.6, b 216.5).
cases.should: A short direct walk: no detour, and no cliff climbed.

cases.name: Elevator: Thunder Bluff, base to top
cases.note: From the foot of the bluff to the top (148 yd up). Only the lifts reach the mesa top.
cases.should: Found by the lift's hand link; terrain alone can't get there. Never up the cliff face.

runs.label: v2
links: Thunder Bluff: lift (west) between Mulgore and the city

cases.name: Mesas and rope bridges: Thousand Needles
cases.note: A mesa top to the Shimmering Flats floor (Mirage Raceway), about 157 yd lower.
cases.should: Use the rope bridges and the Freewind lift links, or say a clear "no way" if a link is missing; never a cliff jump that kills you.

cases.name: Long cross-zone: the Crossroads to Cenarion Hold
cases.note: The goal moved from 31.8, 48.8 (an out-of-bounds plateau south-east of Silithus, the baker found) to Cenarion Hold itself, 30.65, 44.91.
cases.should: Complete (no 60,000-node cap) through the real passes, at a sensible length against straight, within the frame budget.

cases.name: Bridge over a chasm: Thandol Span
cases.note: Dun Modr to the Arathi side. The span is a building (WMO): only its hand link crosses the gorge.
cases.should: Cross the bridge; don't wander off along the gorge or stop at it.

cases.name: One-way drop: the Rustmaul Dig Site
cases.note: Picked from v2's one-way edges: A on a ledge, B 10.9 yd below (a safe fall; 14.57 yd is the most). Straight back up is a 17-yd climb on faces over 50 degrees.
cases.should: A to B: take the drop. B to A: never climb it back; go round.
